name: Methuselah
summary: The son of Enoch and the grandfather of Noah. He lived to be 969 years old.

key_moments.title: Has a Son, Lamech, at 187
key_moments.description: When Methuselah was 187, his son Lamech was born, and he had other sons and daughters after that.

key_moments.title: Dies at 969 Years Old
key_moments.description: Methuselah lived 969 years in all, and then he died.
